d:
Join me on a peaceful and scenic 2-day journey across Rishikesh, Uttarakhand. From quiet morning walks along the holy Ganga and meditating in ancient caves like Vashishta Gufa to exploring the lively cafe scene in Tapovan and visiting iconic suspension bridges, this travel guide covers the best experiences Rishikesh has to offer beyond just the ghats.
If you’re planning a trip to Rishikesh, this episode will help you understand the local commute, sacred ashrams, where to find great food and coffee, and how to balance adventure with spiritual calm.
